title: reference-impl v0.6.1 walker correctness patch line
problem: The v0.6.0 walker shipped 2026-04-24 and was first exercised end-to-end on a real-project Plan (CLV-26, guide-diagrams chs 7/9/10) on 2026-04-26. The walker delivered all 3 tasks to merged status, but the dogfood surfaced eleven bugs ranging from cosmetic (walk-state staleness) to load-bearing (parallel shared-file conflicts that required manual rebase off-walker). Seven of those are concrete, isolated fixes suitable for a focused v0.6.1 patch line; the other four are deferred to v0.6.2 or v0.7 design. The seven in-scope bugs are: (1) walker skill template hard-codes /tmp/walker-* worktree paths, which claw-drive rejects with INVALID_CWD because cwd must be inside $HOME; (2) Reviewer and QA prompts use `git worktree add ... main` to create isolated test worktrees, but this fails inside walker worktrees because the main branch is already checked out in the primary repo; (3) UI Reviewer writes its Playwright script to /tmp/ then runs it from a directory with node_modules/playwright, but Node resolves modules relative to the script file's location, so playwright cannot be found; (4) `cloverleaf-cli prep-worktree` validates that its "main" argument has node_modules installed, but inside a walker worktree the peer worktrees are fresh checkouts without installed deps, causing the command to error with "main missing standard/node_modules"; (5) the UI Reviewer in CLV-27 copied new baselines directly into baselines/chromium/ before the baselines_pending human gate fired, bypassing the approval gate entirely (CLV-29 with the same gate prompt correctly blocked — the same prompt produced divergent Session B behavior, indicating the guard must be enforced at the CLI layer); (6) during CLV-29's rebase, an Edit call failed silently to remove conflict markers from guide.astro, git accepted the rebase as complete, the merge went through, and the site build broke post-merge — the walker needs a defensive grep over changed files before it merges any branch to main; and (7) walk-state.json still reports tasks as state: "running" after the walker drains and merges them, because the drain step in SKILL.md section 5e references the walk-state-write call but does not actually emit it. Together these bugs required multiple manual interventions during the CLV-26 dogfood run that v0.6.1 should eliminate.
solution: The seven bugs cluster by fix location into four groups: (A) walker SKILL.md body — bugs #1, #2, #6, #7 all require edits to reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md; (B) sub-agent prompts — bug #3 requires editing reference-impl/prompts/ui-reviewer.md and bug #5 requires a CLI guard (not a prompt change); (C) CLI layer — bug #4 requires updating reference-impl/lib/prep-worktree.ts to accept the actual primary repo root as the node_modules source when called from inside a walker worktree; and (D) acceptance harness — reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh needs updated scenarios to reproduce bugs #1, #2, and #4. The high-level approach: fix group A first as a single task to avoid co-modification conflicts (bugs #1, #2, #6, #7 all touch SKILL.md and serializing them is safer than parallelizing); fix groups B and C in a second task or pair of tasks (bugs #3, #4, #5 touch different files — ui-reviewer.md, prep-worktree.ts — and can run concurrently); update the acceptance harness in a third task that depends on the CLI fix (bug #4) being merged first so the harness can import the corrected prepWorktree export. For bug #1, the worktree path template in SKILL.md step 5b is changed from `WT="/tmp/walker-<PLAN-ID>-<TASK-ID>"` to `WT="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/cloverleaf/walker/<PLAN-ID>-<TASK-ID>"`, with `mkdir -p "$(dirname "$WT")"` added before the `git worktree add` call so the directory hierarchy is created on first use; for bug #2, Reviewer and QA prompts switch to `git worktree add --detach <path> <sha>` unconditionally, avoiding the branch-held-by-primary-repo collision; for bug #3, the UI Reviewer prompt moves the script file to a directory that has node_modules/playwright resolvable (e.g., inside the worktree or reference-impl/) rather than /tmp/; for bug #4, prep-worktree gains a walker-aware mode that walks up from the provided "main" path to find the actual primary repo root (identified by presence of standard/node_modules and reference-impl/node_modules) or accepts an explicit --primary-root flag; for bug #5, a CLI guard in `cloverleaf-cli` refuses to write files under .cloverleaf/baselines/ when state.json.baselines_pending is true, making the gate enforceable independent of prompt text; for bug #6, the walker's drain merge sequence in SKILL.md gains a grep step that scans changed files for conflict markers (<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) and aborts before git merge --no-ff if any are found; for bug #7, the walk-state-write call is added immediately after a successful git merge --no-ff in the drain step, recording state: "merged" and the merge_commit SHA. For consumers upgrading from v0.6.0 with a stale walk-state.json (tasks stuck at state: "running" from a completed run), the recommended migration is `cloverleaf-run-plan <PLAN-ID> --reset` before the first v0.6.1 invocation; a dedicated reconciler CLI subcommand is not shipped because the blast radius is one file in one repo (CLV-26), all stale entries belong to a fully-completed plan so --reset loses nothing, and the v0.6.1 step-4 reconciler in SKILL.md would self-heal on first invocation except that stale running entries exhaust all concurrency slots and cause immediate exit before reconciliation can run, making --reset the only reliable fix for this edge case. All changes ship as @cloverleaf/reference-impl@0.6.1 with a single CHANGELOG entry under ## 0.6.1. Standard stays at 0.4.1. No external API changes.
acceptance_criteria: All seven bugs have regression tests in reference-impl/tests/ that fail against v0.6.0 behavior and pass against v0.6.1.

reference-impl/scripts/acceptance-walker.sh is updated to reproduce bugs #1 (INVALID_CWD path), #2 (git worktree add main collision), and #4 (prep-worktree node_modules resolution in walker mode), or each gap is explicitly documented in the script with a comment explaining why it cannot be exercised without a live claw-drive session.

A real-project walker run on a follow-up Plan of at least one task drives end-to-end with zero manual rebases and zero driver-side hand-fixes beyond approving routine tool calls and the final-gate prompts.
@cloverleaf/reference-impl version is bumped to 0.6.1 in reference-impl/package.json.
@cloverleaf/standard version remains at 0.4.1 and its package.json is not modified.

reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md contains a ## 0.6.1 section listing all seven bug fixes and a note that consumers upgrading from v0.6.0 should run `cloverleaf-run-plan <PLAN-ID> --reset` before the first v0.6.1 invocation on any plan with a stale walk-state.json from a completed v0.6.0 run.

The walker skill template in reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md uses `WT="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/cloverleaf/walker/<PLAN-ID>-<TASK-ID>"` and no longer references /tmp/walker-* paths anywhere.

Reviewer and QA prompts (reference-impl/prompts/reviewer.md, reference-impl/prompts/qa.md) use `git worktree add --detach` exclusively — no `git worktree add ... main` or any named branch that could be held by the primary repo.
cloverleaf-cli refuses (non-zero exit with a descriptive error) to write into .cloverleaf/baselines/ when the task's ui-review/state.json has baselines_pending: true.
The walker drain sequence in SKILL.md emits a cloverleaf-cli walk-state-write call after each successful merge that sets state: "merged" and records the merge_commit SHA.

No `cloverleaf-cli walk-state-reconcile` subcommand or equivalent one-shot reconciler command is introduced in v0.6.1; upgrade instructions rely solely on --reset as documented in CHANGELOG.md and SKILL.md.
out_of_scope: Dogfood debt item #3: cross-browser system dependency install flow (libevent, libgstreamer, libflite, libavif, gstreamer-libav). Deferred to v0.6.2.
Dogfood debt item #5: chrome-devtools MCP single-profile contention across parallel walker sessions. Deferred to v0.6.2.
Dogfood debt item #8: DAG-edge inference from shared-file modifications. Deferred to v0.7 design.
Changing the walker's external API: skill name, invocation arguments, or exit behavior are unchanged. Only internal skill-body prose and CLI implementation change.
Introducing new tracks, agents, or Standard contracts. The Standard schema stays at 0.4.1.
Retroactively fixing CLV-27's auto-bypassed baselines. Those are already merged on main; the CLI guard from bug #5 applies going forward only.
Fixing state-machine ordering edge case (dogfood bug #9: advance-status called before git merge succeeds). Deferred to v0.6.2.
Shipping a one-shot v0.6.0→v0.6.1 walk-state reconciler subcommand (deferred per CLV-32; --reset is the documented migration path).
